added_failures_note: a figure review runs no suite; no test was executed and no failure count was measured

findings.summary: The 'EFIT boundary and limiter' overlay of cohort_match_summary.png draws three series - the grey EFIT boundary, the red Nova separatrix and the black limiter - with no legend and no direct label, and its title names only the boundary and the limiter. A reader cannot tell that the red curves are the predicted separatrices the run exists to show, and may read them as a second EFIT boundary set.

displacement_decomposition.png joins each landmark's EFIT and Nova positions with a segment drawn in the landmark colour, but the legend lists markers only, so the segments are unnamed. In frames 179 and 44 the X-point segment runs from the upper wall to the lower wall across the whole plasma, and a reader cannot tell it is the X-point displacement rather than a field line or a separatrix.

When a frame's displacement is unavailable (frame 144) the marker loop is skipped entirely, so its panel in displacement_decomposition.png draws no EFIT axis, X-point or centroid, although the companion frame_flux_comparison.png does draw that frame's EFIT axis and EFIT X-point. A reader comparing the two figures sees frame 144's EFIT landmarks in one and not in the other.

findings.disposition: exempted: the two Nova landmarks nearly coincide in R-Z for that frame, so the overlap is the measured geometry; the triangle's apex stays visible above the square and the legend names both
findings.summary: In frame 146's panel the Nova centroid (filled green square) and the Nova axis (filled blue triangle) sit almost on top of one another at the top of the panel, so the square partly covers the triangle. Both remain identifiable by colour and both are named in the legend, but a reader can miss the axis marker.

method: each figure judged only from its rendered PNG at 1400x720 px; the named PNGs were opened directly and panel regions were cropped from those same PNGs to inspect labels, markers and contour clipping before any verdict was recorded

reviewed_prior_findings.note: The nine findings of the r-20261105T172208538923 figure review are answered in the rendered PNGs, checked visually and not re-reported: the blocking 8 pt caption finding is gone (captions are drawn at fontsize 14 and read at column width); Nova contours are clipped to the limiter in every flux panel; the legend's four series (EFIT psi, Nova terminal-current psi, EFIT boundary, Nova separatrix) are all drawn somewhere in the figure; the EFIT and Nova nulls now differ by both colour and glyph (grey open triangle and grey cross versus red filled triangle and red plus); the five cohort metric panels are dot plots on a categorical frame axis with no joining lines; frame 144 is annotated 'unavailable: 144' in each cohort panel; and the first cohort panel's threshold line is labelled 'registered median bar'.
